InventoryMemoryApproachingLimit.reference: k8s/monitoring/prometheus.yaml (expr: process_memory_bytes_simulated > 1000000 for 1m); unreachable by any declared knob because inventory lookup analytics plateau near 100KB

PaymentFailureSpike.reference: k8s/monitoring/prometheus.yaml (expr: rate(payment_failures_total[5m]) > 0.5 for 1m); the rule labels this checkout-service even though payment-service emits the same metric name

PaymentServiceUnhandledErrors.reference: k8s/monitoring/prometheus.yaml (expr: status=~"5.." ratio > 0.10 for 2m); no scenario uses it because the declared error_rate knob trips PaymentServiceHighErrorRate on the same series

description: The fault surface the Meridian reference workload actually exposes: every knob a scenario may set, its type, its bounds and the healthy baseline the adapter verifies before injecting; every alert rule a scenario may fire; every metric a recovery probe may query. A scenario that names anything absent here fails to load. v3 adds checkout-service.metrics_enabled, the first knob that removes a metric source rather than degrading behaviour, so the missing-data category can be measured.

source.name: meridian-shop reference workload
source.reference: k8s/services.yaml declares the healthy baseline env for every deployment; k8s/monitoring/prometheus.yaml declares the alert rules

chaos_mode.description: 50% of post-payment requests fail with db_connection_refused, db_timeout or db_pool_exhausted

error_rate.description: fraction of post-payment requests that fail 500 with a payment-gateway reason and increment payment_failures_total

leak_kb_per_request.description: KB retained per /process call; never freed while the process lives, so only a restart lowers process_memory_bytes_simulated

metrics_enabled.description: when false, /metrics answers 503 while the service keeps serving traffic and /health keeps answering ok; the scrape fails, up goes to 0 and checkout's series become absent rather than zero

slow_rate.description: fraction of successful requests that sleep 1.5-3.5s; latency is observed on the success path only

slow_query_rate.description: fraction of simulated DB queries that take 0.8-2.5s

inventory-service.reference: services/inventory-service/app.py (config dict, simulate_db_query); crash_on_startup is read once at import and is deliberately not declared here because it cannot be set live

rps.description: steady request rate; the mix is 45% checkout, 30% /inventory, 20% /inventory/{id} over six ids of which one does not exist, 5% /reindex

load-generator.reference: load-generator/load_gen.py (config dict, set_config, run_request); not scraped by Prometheus, so its faults are only observable through the services it drives

error_rate.description: fraction of /charge calls that fail 502 with card_declined, insufficient_funds or provider_timeout

provider_down.description: every /charge returns 503 and payment_provider_up drops to 0

slow_rate.description: fraction of /charge calls that sleep 1.0-3.0s, which checkout awaits inline
